subjects.subject: Creative Arts
subjects.name: Basic 3 Creative Arts
subjects.description: Basic 3 Creative Arts helps learners think, plan, create, display and discuss visual and performing artworks drawn from African history, culture, environment and topical issues.

strands.title: VISUAL ARTS – Thinking and Exploring Ideas
strands.description: Generating ideas for visual artworks from African history, culture, environment and topical issues.

subStrands.title: Thinking and Exploring Ideas
subStrands.description: Using experience, observation and imagination to generate ideas for visual artworks.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of how to generate ideas for visual artworks about people, their history and culture, the environment and topical issues.

indicators.description: Study and talk about visual artworks produced or found in other African communities that reflect the history and culture of people in those areas.
Generate ideas from visual artworks produced or found in African communities for creating own artworks about people and their way of life.
Study and talk about visual artworks that show the natural and manmade environment in African communities.
Study and talk about visual artworks that comment on topical local, national or global issues in African communities.

strands.title: VISUAL ARTS – Planning, Making and Composing
strands.description: Planning and producing visual artworks using appropriate tools, materials and techniques.

subStrands.title: Planning, Making and Composing
subStrands.description: Making informed choices of tools, materials and processes to create two- and three-dimensional artworks.

contentStandards.description: Show increased skill in planning, making and composing visual artworks that link ideas, subject matter, media and techniques.

indicators.description: Identify and prepare suitable tools, materials and equipment for creating visual artworks.
Plan and make visual artworks that clearly link ideas, subject matter, media and techniques.
Apply elements and principles of design intentionally when composing visual artworks.
Record and share important stages in the planning and making process of their visual artworks.

strands.title: VISUAL ARTS – Displaying and Sharing
strands.description: Displaying and sharing visual artworks appropriately with different audiences.

subStrands.title: Displaying and Sharing
subStrands.description: Arranging and presenting visual artworks for effective viewing and communication.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of how to display and share visual artworks to support personal, social and cultural development.

indicators.description: Plan and mount displays of visual artworks in appropriate spaces for viewing by different audiences.
Explain reasons for chosen ways of arranging and presenting visual artworks.
Describe how displaying and sharing visual artworks can support personal, social and cultural growth.

strands.title: VISUAL ARTS – Appreciating and Appraising
strands.description: Analysing and talking about visual artworks using agreed guidelines.

subStrands.title: Appreciating and Appraising
subStrands.description: Developing guidelines for viewing, interpreting and judging visual artworks.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of how to analyse, appreciate and appraise visual artworks and present simple reports.

indicators.description: Agree on guidelines for viewing visual artworks and expressing personal feelings and thoughts about them, including works from other African communities.
Use agreed guidelines to examine, interpret and appraise visual artworks and report findings.

strands.title: PERFORMING ARTS – Thinking and Exploring Ideas
strands.description: Generating ideas for music, dance and drama performances from experience, environment and imagination.

subStrands.title: Thinking and Exploring Ideas
subStrands.description: Using experience, observation and imagination to generate ideas for performing arts.

contentStandards.description: Demonstrate understanding of how to generate ideas for performances about people, their history and culture, the environment and topical issues.

indicators.description: Study and talk about performing artworks in other African communities that reflect history and culture or way of life.
Generate ideas from performing artworks produced or performed in African communities for creating own performances.
Study and talk about performing artworks that reflect natural and manmade environments in African communities.
Study and talk about performing artworks that address topical issues in African communities.

strands.title: PERFORMING ARTS – Planning, Making and Composing
strands.description: Planning and creating music, dance and drama performances using appropriate resources.

subStrands.title: Planning, Making and Composing
subStrands.description: Choosing and organising tools, materials and techniques to create performances.

contentStandards.description: Show increased skill in planning and creating performances that link ideas, subject matter, media and techniques.

indicators.description: Identify and prepare tools, materials and resources for composing and performing music, dance and drama.
Plan and create performances that clearly link ideas, subject matter, media and techniques.
Apply elements and principles of performing arts when composing and staging performances.
Record and share important stages in the planning and rehearsal process.

strands.title: PERFORMING ARTS – Displaying and Sharing
strands.description: Presenting and sharing music, dance and drama performances with different audiences.

subStrands.title: Displaying and Sharing
subStrands.description: Arranging, presenting and reflecting on performances.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of how to present and share performances to support personal, social and cultural development.

indicators.description: Plan and present performances for appropriate audiences and settings.
Explain reasons for chosen ways of presenting and sharing performances.
Describe how presenting and sharing performances can support personal, social and cultural growth.

strands.title: PERFORMING ARTS – Appreciating and Appraising
strands.description: Analysing and talking about performances using agreed guidelines.

subStrands.title: Appreciating and Appraising
subStrands.description: Developing and applying guidelines for viewing, listening to and judging performances.

contentStandards.description: Show understanding of how to analyse, appreciate and appraise performances and present simple reports.

indicators.description: Agree on guidelines for viewing and listening to performances and expressing personal responses, including performances from other African communities.
Use agreed guidelines to examine, interpret and appraise performances and report findings.
